end_market_exposure.detail: Mainly farm nitrogen fertilizer; also power, ethanol, diesel emissions fluid, industrial and food-grade CO2 uses.

manufacturing_type.detail: Continuous chemical process: gasification or natural gas reforming to ammonia, upgraded to UAN and urea.

notes: Production model inferred from commodity fertilizer industry knowledge, not stated in evidence.

product_complexity.detail: Standardized nitrogen fertilizers (ammonia, UAN, urea) sold on grade specifications.

production_model.detail: Produces fertilizer continuously and sells from inventory and storage to distributors and farmers.

production_role.detail: Produces nitrogen fertilizer and industrial chemicals sold as inputs to agriculture and industry.
